caption:
My first real program, in C. Five lines, one compiler, and the same idea that runs every smart contract 🧙

Day 2 of learning crypto security from zero.

#learntocode #cprogramming #cs50 #solidity #web3 #codingjourney

scenes.say: Week one of Harvard's CS fifty. My first *real* program, in C.
Five lines. The first one borrows a toolbox called standard I O. *Main* is where the program starts. And *printf* prints text to the screen.
But computers don't read C. A *compiler* translates it into zeros and ones. In the terminal: make hello, then dot slash hello.
Smart contracts work the same way. *Solidity* code gets compiled into *bytecode*, and that's what the blockchain actually runs.
Next up, variables and conditions. Follow the journey.
